```{r, echo=TRUE}
# load pre-computed objects for rendering
# markers of the final labels from 1, every gene against every cluster
# significant gene whatever its effect size
cluster_markers      = read.csv(paste0(atlas_dir, "/cluster_marker_genes_unfiltered.csv")) 
gene_descriptions    = read.csv(paste0(altas_results_dir, "/gene_descritption.csv"))
lineage_ob = readRDS(paste0(pseudo_results_dir, "/Robjects/lineage_objects.Rds"))
germ_pseudotime = read.csv(paste0(pseudo_results_dir, "/pseudotime_per_cell.csv"))
combined.sce = readRDS(paste0(altas_results_dir, "/combined.sce.Rds"))
```

## Cell metadata export

```{r}
# keyed by final_label from 13; the order here is the order of every legend
# and axis below
anno = c("1"              = "1. Fibroblasts",
         "2"              = "2. Mesonephric cells",
         "3"              = "3. Migrating erythrocytes",
         "4"              = "4. Granulosa cells",
         "5"              = "5. PGCs/oogonia/oocytes",
         "6"              = "6. Endothelial cells",
         "7"              = "7. Podocytes",
         "8"              = "8. Erythrocytes",
         "9"              = "9. Migrating pre-granulosa cells",
         "10"             = "10. Hemopoietic stem cells",
         "11"             = "11. Migrating leukocytes",
         "12_transformer" = "12T. Bipotential gonadal supporting cells",
         "12_larva"       = "12L. Mitotic macrophages",
         "13"             = "13. Macrophages",
         "14"             = "14. Migrating/mitotic pre-granulosa cells",
         "15"             = "15. Mitotic spermatogonia",
         "16"             = "16. Spermatocytes I",
         "17"             = "17. Spermatocytes II",
         "18"             = "18. Migrating spermatocytes")

level_order = names(anno)
anno_order  = unname(anno)
# the number in front of each name, "12T" and "12L" for the split cluster, for
# labels drawn on the plots
anno_short  = setNames(sub("\\..*$", "", anno), names(anno))

all_clusters = 
  read.csv(paste0(atlas_dir, "/cell_cluster_labels.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type = unname(anno[as.character(final_label)])) %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, final_label, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cluster = "final_label")

# every label must have an annotation and every annotation a label
stopifnot(setequal(level_order, unique(all_clusters$cluster)))

all.sce  = readRDS(paste0(altas_results_dir, "/all.sce.Rds"))

cell_meta = dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(all.sce, function(x)
  as.data.frame(colData(x)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(barcode = colnames(x),
                  dplyr::across(dplyr::where(~ inherits(.x, "outlier.filter")),
                                as.logical)))) %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, sum, detected, subsets_Mito_percent) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_clusters, by = "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_label = unname(anno_short[cluster]))

merged.sce  = readRDS(paste0(altas_results_dir, "/merged.sce.Rds"))  

# the embeddings are attached by position, so the cells must be in the same order
stopifnot(identical(cell_meta$barcode, colnames(merged.sce)))

all_tsne      = reducedDim(merged.sce, "TSNE")
all_corrected = reducedDim(merged.sce, "corrected")
colnames(all_corrected) = paste0("fastMNN.corrected.", seq_len(ncol(all_corrected)))

cell_meta$TSNE1 = all_tsne[, "TSNE1"]
cell_meta$TSNE2 = all_tsne[, "TSNE2"]
cell_meta = cbind(cell_meta, all_corrected)

germ_corrected = as.data.frame(reducedDim(lineage_ob$corrected, "corrected"))
colnames(germ_corrected) = paste0("germ.fastMNN.corrected.", seq_len(ncol(germ_corrected)))
germ_corrected$barcode = rownames(germ_corrected)

germ_meta = 
  dplyr::left_join(germ_pseudotime, germ_corrected, by = "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::select(-cluster, -annotation, -library, -stage)

meta_final =
  cell_meta %>%
  dplyr::left_join(germ_meta, by = "barcode", relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::rename(trajectory.node = "node")

write.table(meta_final,
            file      = paste0(altas_results_dir, "/cell_metadata.tsv"),
            row.names = FALSE,
            sep       = "\t",
            quote     = FALSE)

# gzip, which is what the .gz extension says; zip() writes a zip archive
write.table(meta_final,
            file      = gzfile(paste0(altas_results_dir, "/cell_metadata.tsv.gz")),
            row.names = FALSE,
            sep       = "\t",
            quote     = FALSE)
```

## Add meta data

```{r}
# set coldata
rownames(cell_meta) = cell_meta$barcode
cell_meta_ordered <- cell_meta[colnames(combined.sce), , drop = FALSE]
colData(combined.sce) <- DataFrame(cell_meta_ordered)

# set rowdata
rownames(gene_descriptions) = gene_descriptions$Gene
gene_descriptions_ordered = gene_descriptions[rownames(combined.sce), , drop = FALSE]
rowData(combined.sce) = DataFrame(gene_descriptions_ordered)
```

### PIWIL1 and SYCP3

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5, dev = "png", dpi = 600}
violin_panel = function(goi)
  plot_violin_goi_single(sce              = combined.sce,
                         markers          = cluster_markers,
                         goi              = goi,
                         gene_description = gene_descriptions,
                         anno             = anno_order,
                         palette          = publication_palette,
                         label_col        = "cluster",
                         title            = goi,
                         level_order      = level_order)

# both panels carry the same cell type legend, so collecting the guides leaves
# one copy at the right
p_piwil1_sycp3 = (violin_panel("PIWIL1") | violin_panel("SYCP3")) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

p_piwil1_sycp3
ggsave(p_piwil1_sycp3, file = paste0(results_dir, "/PIWIL1_SYCP3.png"),
       width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 600)
```

### PIWIL1 and SYCP3 by library

The same genes with all cells pooled, as in the figure above, and then each
library drawn on its own. The pooled panel mixes libraries, and the male library carries both genes in its somatic clusters,
likely ambient RNA from its spermatocytes. Here a cluster is compared with the
clusters of its own library, which is how the marker test compares them. A
cluster with fewer than 10 cells in a library is left out of that panel. Stars
are drawn on the pooled panel only, at FDR < 0.05 as in the figure above,
because the marker test gives one FDR per cluster rather than one per library.

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=7, dev = "png", dpi = 600}
# the pooled panel first, then the libraries
lib_order     = c("All cells", "Undifferentiated.1", "Undifferentiated.2",
                  "Female", "Male")
min_lib_cells = 10

cell_lab = read.csv(paste0(atlas_dir, "/cell_cluster_labels.csv"),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lab_idx  = match(colnames(combined.sce), cell_lab$barcode)
stopifnot(!anyNA(lab_idx))

violin_by_library = function(goi) {
  gene_id = gene_descriptions$Gene[match(goi, gene_descriptions$WangGeneID)]
  stopifnot(!is.na(gene_id), gene_id %in% rownames(combined.sce))

  per_lib = data.frame(cluster = cell_lab$final_label[lab_idx],
                       library = cell_lab$library[lab_idx],
                       expr    = logcounts(combined.sce)[gene_id, ],
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # every cell again under one label, so the pooled panel is the same data
  d = dplyr::bind_rows(per_lib %>% dplyr::mutate(library = "All cells"),
                       per_lib) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(library, cluster) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= min_lib_cells) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    # cluster 1 at the top, in the order of the other figures
    dplyr::mutate(short   = factor(unname(anno_short[cluster]),
                                   levels = rev(unname(anno_short))),
                  type    = factor(unname(anno[cluster]), levels = anno_order),
                  library = factor(library, levels = lib_order))

  # stars as plot_violin_goi_single draws them: FDR < 0.05, just past the
  # cluster's highest cell, on the pooled panel
  stars = cluster_markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(WangGeneID == goi, FDR < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(cluster = as.character(cluster)) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(d %>%
                        dplyr::filter(library == "All cells") %>%
                        dplyr::group_by(cluster, short) %>%
                        dplyr::summarise(x_pos = max(expr) * 1.1, .groups = "drop"),
                      by = "cluster") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(library = factor("All cells", levels = lib_order))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = expr, y = short, fill = type)) +
    geom_violin(aes(color = after_scale(fill)), orientation = "y",
                linewidth = 0.3, scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(orientation = "y", width = 0.12, fill = "white",
                 color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_text(data = stars, aes(x = x_pos, y = short, label = "*"),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.8, vjust = 0.75, fontface = "bold",
              color = "#2e2e2e") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = publication_palette, name = "Cell Type",
                      drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    # room past the highest cell for the stars
    scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
    facet_grid(. ~ library) +
    labs(x = "Log-normalized expression", y = NULL, title = goi) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.text       = element_text(color = "#3a3a3a", size = 7),
          axis.ticks.y    = element_blank(),
          axis.line       = element_line(color = "#aaaaaa", linewidth = 0.4),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text      = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
          plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 8))
}

p_piwil1_sycp3_lib = (violin_by_library("PIWIL1") / violin_by_library("SYCP3")) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

p_piwil1_sycp3_lib
ggsave(p_piwil1_sycp3_lib, file = paste0(results_dir, "/PIWIL1_SYCP3_by_library.png"),
       width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 600)
```

### S18: zp, alox5 and nxph1 enriched in oogonia and oocytes, and pfn2 and mmp19 enriched in immune cells

```{r, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=13, dev = "png", dpi = 600}
zp_id =
  gene_descriptions %>%
  filter(grepl("ZP", WangGeneID),
         WangGeneID != "ZPR1") %>%
  pull(Gene)

# A: oogonia and oocytes. Both NXPH1 loci, LOC116940857 (NXPH1) and
# LOC116949363 (NXPH1.1).
oocyte_id = c("ALOX5",
              "LOC116940857",
              "LOC116949363",
              zp_id)
# B: immune cells, PFN2 and MMP19
immune_id = c("LOC116952631",
              "LOC116938704")

goi_of = function(ids)
  gene_descriptions %>%
  filter(Gene %in% ids) %>%
  pull(WangGeneID)

s18_panel = function(ids)
  plot_violin_goi(sce              = combined.sce,
                  markers          = cluster_markers,
                  goi              = goi_of(ids),
                  gene_description = gene_descriptions,
                  anno             = anno_order,
                  palette          = publication_palette,
                  label_col        = "cluster",
                  level_order      = level_order,
                  title            = NULL,
                  ncol             = 2)

# each panel's height follows its number of rows of genes, so the violins are
# the same size in both
s18_rows = c(ceiling(length(goi_of(oocyte_id)) / 2),
             ceiling(length(goi_of(immune_id)) / 2))

p_s18 = (s18_panel(oocyte_id) / s18_panel(immune_id)) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = s18_rows, guides = "collect") +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

p_s18
ggsave(p_s18, file = paste0(results_dir, "/FigS18_genes.png"),
       width = 7.5, height = 2 + 0.6 * sum(s18_rows), dpi = 600)
```
